resources.string: Allow background activity to keep the VPN running when using other apps. System restrictions, another VPN, or a process crash can still end the connection; this page cannot override system settings.

On Huawei devices, search Settings for App launch. Disable automatic management for Pure Proxy, then allow auto-launch, secondary launch, and background activity. In Battery optimization, select all apps and set Pure Proxy to “Don’t allow” optimization. Disable power saving while testing. You can also lock the app card in Recents. For other devices, allow unrestricted battery use and background activity. In system VPN settings, optionally enable Always-on VPN if supported. Only enable “Block connections without VPN” if you accept losing connectivity whenever this VPN stops.
VPN permission revoked or VPN replaced

This is the last saved event, not a live connection check. If the VPN icon disappears but the record still says connected, the process may have been killed or crashed without a cleanup callback; it does not prove which cause occurred. Record this page after the next unexpected disconnect, before reconnecting.
This settings page is not available on your device. Open system Settings manually.
